verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a self-serve export of contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history or the suppression list. The only related material is the API: paginated contact retrieval and campaign click reports. Those are developer building blocks someone could use to build an export, not an export capability, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can export my entire audience — contacts, custom fields, tags, engagement history, and suppression list — in an open format, self-serve

citations.quote: When you request a collection of entities, such as contacts belonging to a list, the data will be paginated rather than returned all at once.
